description: The production evaluation portfolio: three active lifecycle-v0 lanes, each ordered feature implementation, behavior-preserving refactor, and code review/correction. Each lane has two retained operational baseline replicates and is ready for compatible treatment comparison.

persist_between_tasks: repository source working tree and model-facing Git metadata from one composite broken-start root
memory/state stores enabled by the active profile

sequences.reset_policy: Reset once before the lane; preseed the missing feature, behavior-preserving structural debt, and flawed review candidate into one concealed composite root; preserve repository, Git, tool, index, cache, generated configuration, memory, and agent state across prompts; run every concealed verifier after the final prompt.
sequences.seed_patch_policy: Controller merges all three independently qualified lifecycle start conditions into one composite broken start before provider execution. Prompts are disclosed sequentially; the proposed review patch is disclosed only with task 3; acceptance assets remain controller-only; every verifier runs after the final prompt.
sequences.conversion_note: One persistent lifecycle adds request media-type metadata, refactors shared Content-Type parsing reuse without behavior change, and reviews an authentic pre-review onMaxParamLength status-code flaw.
sequences.complexity_note: Authentic feature, disclosed structural/performance refactor, and concrete flawed-change review use disjoint production surfaces.
sequences.complexity_bar: Each class has an executable fixed/start gate; the refactor separately proves behavior preservation and structural nonconformance.
